account: AgileSoDA and ASICLAND announced their chip design partnership in January 2023. ASICLAND is a data and deployment partner. In its submission to the ITU AI for Good report of 2025, AgileSoDA reports that partner deployments cut floor-planning time by 76%, from more than a week to roughly a day. It also reports that overall duration fell by 20% for high-density designs. These aggregate first-party results are not allocated to individual designs. On 8 December 2025 the Korean newspaper Hankyung reported that a KOSDAQ-listed company had tested the placement tool in a TSMC process. Hankyung cited no named source and gave no outcome figures. It also reported that AgileSoDA was still developing ChipNSoDA.

ai_role.statement: Reinforcement learning automates physical chip layout and floor planning. The reported time reductions are attributed to this design workflow, without an independent component comparison.
